title: YAT.lifestyle Element at-home perfume test kit concept images

images.description: Closed matte-black kit box with small gold dropper emblem in soft morning light.
images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: 01-box-closed.png, photorealistic luxury packaging concept photograph, landscape 4:3 canvas (prefer 1536 x 1152), one full-bleed scene.
Primary request: Recompose the established Element kit from reference image 1 into its closed-box product view. Fit the same rigid lift-off lid onto the same base. Preserve the black wrapping texture, square edges, size and proportions. Show just the closed box resting on a warm ivory stone surface, photographed from a calm three-quarter angle with the entire box visible and quiet breathing room.
Input images: Image 1 is the established open-kit object-identity reference; image 2 is the dropper-emblem reference, use only its upper emblem and omit all its words; image 3 is the Hong Kong daylight/material reference.
Gold emblem: centered on the lid, small and fine gold foil, based on the reference's vertical pipette and suspended droplet enclosed by two elegant curved bottle-outline strokes. A tiny tasteful mark occupying about one-tenth of lid width, no printed lettering.
Lighting/mood: soft Hong Kong morning window light from one side, warm creamy tabletop, subtle naturally patterned window shadow in the background, black matte lid still reads as deeply black, glints of gold restrained to the emblem. Photorealistic tactile paper wrapping and subtle film grain, precise square construction, understated premium product photography. No extra props, no loose vials, no hands or faces, no labels or slogans.
YAT.lifestyle Element is a Hong Kong perfume-house concept for an approximately 30-minute at-home scent test followed by perfume tuning. Restrained luxury and real laboratory precision. Palette: ink black #080806, carbon #0d0d0b, warm white #f1eadc, paper #ece5d8, very sparing liquid gold #d8a443. Square edges, hairline rules, realistic optical glass, subtly textured paper and a trace of film grain. The kit is a low rectangular rigid matte-black paper-wrapped box approximately 30 x 22 x 5 cm with a separate lift-off lid. Lid exterior has only a small gold foil dropper emblem: a slender vertical pipette with a little suspended droplet, framed by two fine outward-curving bottle-outline strokes; no brand lettering. Inner lid carries a fitted matte warm-white measurement card. LOCKED BOARD LAYOUT: four black square ArUco-like corner markers; near the top a row of white, 18% gray, and black calibration patches followed by a short row of restrained color swatches; a tiny QR pattern near the upper right; the middle-left oil region contains three equal side-by-side rectangular sheet-placement windows filled with fine black-and-white vertical stripes; lower-left a slim pH-strip recess beside a short printed pH color scale; lower-right a rectangular evaporation placement zone with fine stripe pattern; fine millimetre tick ruler across the bottom edge. Use hairline borders and tiny functional marks, no readable prose or zone titles. Base insert is fitted carbon-black foam with precision individual cutouts. INVENTORY: exactly five small amber-glass sensitivity vials with black ribbed caps bearing tiny numbers 1–5; four slightly larger clear-glass base-scent vials with satin-gold caps and tiny A–D codes; a sealed small clear glass vial containing one pale-yellow lemon slice/peel; one slim glass dropper with black rubber bulb; fine stainless-steel tweezers; a neatly stacked bundle of white scent strips; one small paper packet of oil-blotting sheets; one slim tube of pH strips; one tiny water vial; one small black-bulb glass dropper bottle filled with clear unscented solution; two thin paper blotter cards; one slim neutral paper pack of unscented wipes; a fold-out paper ruler strip with small numeric marks 10 / 30 / 60 cm; one folded warm-white instruction card with a small QR pattern. Two separate plain clear borosilicate petri dishes approximately 8 cm diameter with fitted lids, one lid with the single word "RESET" in thin widely spaced gold capitals and the other with the single word "SPENT" in matching gold capitals. Text is restricted to RESET, SPENT, tiny functional numbers and vial codes, and QR/marker patterns. No marketing text, invented labels, other brand logos, watermarks, people's faces, decorative gold fields, colorful plastic, toy-like apparatus, or unsupported scientific claims.
All inner kit contents are enclosed and invisible. Preserve the product identity of the master reference.
